title: Keyless Covert Communication Over Quantum MACs with General Message Sets
summary: We study covert classical communication over quantum multiple-access channels (MACs) with general message sets. Specifically, we consider a fully quantum MAC with arbitrary message sets and an arbitrary number of transmitters. We demonstrate the feasibility of achieving a positive covert rate over this channel and establish general one-shot and asymptotic achievable rate regions. For classical-quantum MACs with general message sets, we establish the covert capacity, when the transmitters are restricted to deterministic encoding.
